description: Resume Reviewer Tool - Complete redesign of /[locale]/tools/resume-reviewer with TealHQ visual/functional parity. Supports PDF upload, text paste, select existing resume. AI analysis with ATS score, categorized feedback, and optional job matching. Fully public (no auth required).

userStories.title: Create page layout structure matching TealHQ
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Resume Reviewer page to have the same visual structure as TealHQ so the experience feels professional and familiar.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section with title, subtitle, and brief description
Main content area with input section prominently displayed
Proper spacing and padding matching TealHQ
userStories.notes: Created page.tsx and resume-reviewer-client.tsx following resume-checker pattern. Added translations for all 4 locales. Removed from [tool]/page.tsx VALID_TOOL_SLUGS. Code review: PASS.

userStories.title: Implement PDF upload input method
userStories.description: As a user, I want to upload my resume as a PDF so I can get it analyzed without retyping.
acceptanceCriteria: Drag-and-drop zone with visual feedback on hover/drag
Click to browse file picker (PDF only)
Error state for invalid file type or size
Uploaded file name displayed with remove option
PDF text extraction via existing API or new endpoint
Verify in browser: upload a PDF and see filename displayed
userStories.notes: Drag-drop zone, file validation, extraction via /api/tools/extract-text.

userStories.title: Implement text paste input method
userStories.description: As a user, I want to paste my resume text directly so I can quickly get feedback without uploading a file.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab switching between input methods (Upload / Paste / Select)
Verify in browser: paste text and see character count update
userStories.notes: Textarea with character count, clear button, 100-char minimum.

userStories.title: Implement select existing resume input method
userStories.description: As a logged-in user, I want to select one of my existing resumes so I don't have to re-upload.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown or card selector showing user's resumes (if authenticated)
Shows 'Sign in to access your resumes' message if not authenticated
Graceful handling when user has no resumes
Verify in browser: shows sign-in prompt when not logged in
userStories.notes: Resume card selector, Supabase fetch, JSONB text extraction.

userStories.title: Implement optional job description input
userStories.description: As a user, I want to optionally add a job description so the analysis can tell me how well my resume matches.
acceptanceCriteria: Textarea for pasting job description text
Job description included in analysis request when provided
Verify in browser: expand section and paste job description
userStories.notes: Collapsible accordion, optional badge, character count.

userStories.title: Create analysis loading state
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear feedback while my resume is being analyzed so I know the system is working.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze Resume button with loading spinner when processing
Progress indication or animated placeholder in results area
Estimated time or 'This may take a moment' message
Verify in browser: click analyze and see loading state

userStories.title: Create API endpoint for resume analysis
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API endpoint that accepts resume text and optional job description, returning comprehensive analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses Groq SDK for AI analysis
Proper error handling with meaningful messages
userStories.notes: Created /api/tools/review-resume with Groq SDK, 5 categories, job match.

userStories.title: Display overall ATS score
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my overall ATS score prominently so I quickly understand how my resume performs.
acceptanceCriteria: Large circular or semi-circular score indicator (0-100)
Score label (ATS Score or Resume Score)
Verify in browser: see animated score after analysis
userStories.notes: SVG circular gauge, counting animation, color-coded interpretation.

userStories.title: Display categorized section scores
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see scores for different categories (Impact, Brevity, Style, etc.) so I know which areas need work.
acceptanceCriteria: Categories: Impact, Brevity, Style, Sections, Skills (or TealHQ equivalents)
Individual score per category (percentage or out of 10)
Verify in browser: see all category scores displayed
userStories.notes: 5 category cards with icons, animated progress bars.

userStories.title: Display detailed feedback and suggestions
userStories.description: As a user, I want detailed, actionable feedback for each category so I can improve my resume.
acceptanceCriteria: Bullet-point list of specific issues found
Verify in browser: expand category and see detailed feedback
userStories.notes: Expandable cards, priority-ranked suggestions, positive indicators.

userStories.title: Display job match analysis (when job description provided)
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see how well my resume matches the job description so I can tailor it appropriately.
acceptanceCriteria: Section only visible when job description was provided
Verify in browser: provide job description and see match analysis
userStories.notes: JobMatchSection with compact gauge, keyword pills.

userStories.title: Implement error states and edge cases
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear error messages when something goes wrong so I can take corrective action.
acceptanceCriteria: Error state for PDF parsing failure
Verify in browser: trigger error and see friendly message
userStories.notes: User-friendly error messages, retry button, pre-validation.

userStories.title: Add Analyze Another reset functionality
userStories.description: As a user, I want to easily analyze another resume without refreshing the page.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze Another Resume button in results section
Verify in browser: click reset and see form cleared
userStories.notes: Reset button, state clearing, smooth scroll.

userStories.title: Ensure responsive design parity
userStories.description: As a user on mobile/tablet, I want the same quality experience as desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile layout matches TealHQ mobile view
Tablet layout matches TealHQ tablet view
Verify in browser: test at 375px, 768px, 1024px widths
userStories.notes: 48px touch targets, responsive text, sm: breakpoints.

userStories.title: Final visual parity review
userStories.description: As a product owner, I want side-by-side visual parity confirmed before release.
acceptanceCriteria: No visible differences in spacing, colors, typography
userStories.notes: Code review PASS. All components production-ready.
